verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform with an SDK and CLI. Nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out. The integrated logging and sandbox logs API are user-facing observability features, and the 'opt into a more performant Sandbox backend' item is a performance setting; neither relates to telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
